resources.string: Enter the address of your Kagaz PDF server to get started.
This app connects to a Kagaz PDF server that you run, for example on your computer (use its Wi-Fi address like 192.168.1.5:8080). Use https for servers on the internet.
Enter a valid address. Plain http is only allowed for local or private network servers.
Can\'t reach this server. Check the address and your connection.
The secure connection failed. The server\'s certificate is not trusted.
The server\'s certificate is not trusted, so the connection was blocked.
